# Database & Authentication Checklist: Core Architecture & Stability Audit

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, safety, and quality of requirements for foundational database migrations and the authentication state refactor (Developer A's assignments).
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///D:/Course/Projects/graduation-mate/specs/001-core-stability-audit/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Database & RLS Safety Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are the RLS SELECT policy requirements for `profiles` clearly defined to prevent unauthorized bulk data harvesting? [Spec §DB-01, §R10]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the RLS INSERT policy requirements for the `matches` table explicitly specified to restrict creation to involving the caller's own profile? [Spec §DB-02, §R1]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the specification define the access control and restrictions for the `resetSwipes` function to prevent destructive data loss in production? [Spec §DB-03, §R3]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the database constraints for enforcing strict single-team membership (e.g., `UNIQUE` constraint on `team_members`) explicitly defined in the data model? [Spec §DB-05]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the clean removal of the duplicate `profiles.team_id` column specified as part of the schema normalization requirements? [Spec §DB-05]

## Migration Sequencing & Rollback Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 Are the migration rollback paths and script requirements documented for schema changes affecting RLS policies or unique constraints? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the plan define the deployment sequencing and schema migration order to prevent production downtime or data access loss during migration? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the disaster recovery and database backup expectations specified prior to executing the schema normalization migration? [Gap]

## Authentication State & Context Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Are the state lifecycle and initialization requirements for the global `AuthProvider` context explicitly defined? [Spec §R4]
- [ ] CHK010 Does the specification define the cleanup and expiration criteria for the `LOGOUT_KEY` storage sentinel to prevent crash lockout? [Spec §AUTH-03, §R8]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the requirements for synchronizing auth state across tabs and window instances documented? [Spec §AUTH-05]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the migration requirements for refactoring pages from `useCurrentUser` to the new global `useAuth` hook clearly outlined? [Spec §R4]

## Correctness & Hook/Query Testing Requirements

- [ ] CHK013 Are the unit test requirements and success criteria defined for custom hooks (`useAuth`, `useSwipe`) to prevent authentication state regressions? [Spec §Constitution, §R4]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the plan define test requirements for verifying database query helpers under standard authentication states? [Spec §Constitution, §R4]
- [ ] CHK015 Are mock testing requirements defined for validating RLS policy enforcement? [Gap]
